## What changes

"Wie neemt het over" in the context form was a single free text field. A note can go to more than one person.

- **Pick one or more** colleagues from the Medewerkers group (the same group as "Samen met" under Draagt). They toggle in green.
- **Anyone else** goes in the field next to them, by name or role. Several names can be typed with commas; with an empty group the field says so.
- **Stored as one line of names** in the existing `successor` column (for example "Jens Demeyer, Sofie Claeys, nieuwe werfleider"). The note shows "neemt over: …", and the Bespreken list, the "Met wie het overneemt" filter, the search and the CSV keep working unchanged. No migration.

## Tests

- Two colleagues and a typed name are kept on the note in the order picked; the selection clears after saving.
- 337 pass; pint clean. Checked in the browser with two colleagues and a typed role.
